label: Crafts and decorative arts
description: Named craft techniques and decorative traditions in glass, tile, textiles, paper, metal, lacquer, and ceramics.
notes: Named decorative techniques and craft traditions belong here, phrased as made objects after “made as.” art.medium provides broad material choices, while art.rendering owns simulated digital construction looks and art.style owns movements. Brief visual descriptions identify surfaces, stitches, cuts, and motifs rather than prescribing a subject. The wood_lacquer group also holds scrimshaw on bone, and glass_tile includes decorative stone inlay. Traditional techniques remain usable in contemporary scenes and carry no descent or regional restrictions.
